- After selecting the character options, the difficulty setting UI will appear.
- Difficulty settings can be accessed from the pause menu.
- For the previous saved game, the difficulty option will receive one chance to review and adjust the settings.

- Not all options are available to change during gameplay.

[Fixed]

- Fixed AOO won't trigger for the player for some cases.

[Update]

- Reduced the amount of junk items spawning in the world.
- Volatile Extract can be crafted after researching Blast Berry. Also some monster spoils drops them too.
- Clicking on the exit icons in the map UI will attempt to show the map linked to that icon (only works if the level has been added to the map).
- Most of the perks are available to view from the beginning of the game except Nano perks and few others. Show All toggle has been added to hide the perks that are not yet available to unlock.

notes.notes:
Version 1.17 [2024-03-24]

[Fixed]

- Addressed a rare occurrence where the player would become invisible, and performing an attack could soft-lock the game.
- Resolved a game soft-lock issue for PCs with fewer than 4 CPU cores. While the game's minimum specification requires 4 CPU cores, this fix allows it to function on systems with fewer cores, although performance may still be impacted.
- Fixed an issue where HP damage caused by environmental hazards such as fire and acid was not being displayed.

[Update]

- Added a new settings option, "Simulation Type." This optimization to the main simulation engine allows for faster performance by simplifying off-level simulations. This option may be beneficial in late-game situations, especially for less powerful PCs.
- Added a new settings option, "Walk Duration." This setting adjusts the walking speed of all characters, potentially making movement quicker or slower. However, excessively fast speeds may cause player discomfort, while slower speeds can provide smoother movement.

notes.title: Subterrain Mines of Titan public demo release date
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40087544/1e455594cd9bdb57f9e36b132f73326eee4c8dc6.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

We are happy to announce that the public demo for the Subterrain Mines of Titan will be released a bit earlier than the official Steam Next date.

It will be released around [b]10 PDT time on 2nd of June.[/b]

We still think the demo is not yet 100% ready, but we wanted to release it sooner so that the press can play the demo ahead of the Steam Fest.

We will still be updating the demo all the way to the main game release.

This is very exciting, yet very nervous time for us, and we are expecting a lot of feedback and bugs to popping up! So please do give us any feedback, bug report by Steam forum or at our Discord channel.

Thank you and we are looking forward to hearing from you!
